project-orderfield/PROJECT-DOC-002.rationale:
Project assertion project-orderfield-project-doc-002. Declared coverage: complete for all applicable conditions of the selected requirement. Conditions: Same beat: **must ask** once for agent-band `1-4` / `5-10` / `10-50` + optional multi-model; store `of patch --agent-band` / `--multi-model`. Children default medium. Do not re-ask each wave. Host RAM suggests a band (`of doctor` `ram_total_gb`) — wave budget, not a spawn cap..
Negative controls to review: Assert that omitted or invalid agent-band input prompts or defaults according to host RAM thresholds..
domain assumptions: Host RAM detection and agent-band budgeting in orderfield doctor and patch..
data assumptions: Standard memory queries on Linux/macOS/Windows..
performance assumptions: Host RAM test suite completes under 10 seconds..
Limits: Covers agent-band querying, host RAM detection, and wave budget storage; does not govern live subagent OS memory usage.

project-orderfield/PROJECT-DOC-011.rationale:
Project assertion project-orderfield-project-doc-011. Declared coverage: complete for all applicable conditions of the selected requirement. Conditions: A residual may say `status=done` with a `result_ref`. That closes a slice. It does not close SPEC. Done close evidence must name `artifact_sha:` (sha256 of `result_ref` bytes) and `rollback:` a command — not captions (`CloseEvidence`). Collect refuses a mismatch or a slogan rollback. `integrate --apply` may set `done_when_closed` from a residual; `of phase` stays explicit; `of close` still needs RESOLVED..
Negative controls to review: Close residual with mismatched artifact_sha or slogan rollback is rejected at collect..
domain assumptions: Close honesty and evidence verification in regime.py..
data assumptions: Residual JSON and artifact on disk..
performance assumptions: Test runs under 15 seconds..
Limits: Verifies close evidence artifact SHA and rollback command enforcement on slice completion.
These are project-authored coverage claims; TLTFIA has not validated their semantic completeness.

project-orderfield/PROJECT-DOC-012.rationale:
Project assertion project-orderfield-project-doc-012. Declared coverage: complete for all applicable conditions of the selected requirement. Conditions: Generic done-when (`current phase criteria closed with evidence`, `done.`, `all done`) dies at init/patch. Empty or theater active sets cannot stamp `done_when_closed`. That theater is `recovery/done-when-lint`. Production-mode / day-90 fields must also name a repo-relative runbook path in `done_when` before close (`RunbookPath`); toy fields stay on the contrast-bound default..
Negative controls to review: Generic done-when text or missing runbook path in production-mode causes regime refusal..
domain assumptions: Done-when linting and runbook path verification..
data assumptions: ORDER done_when field values..
performance assumptions: Gate tests run under 10 seconds..
Limits: Verifies rejection of theater done-when statements and requirement of valid runbook paths.
